dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple light-intensity annular structures with diffused outer edges. One primary closed circular ring is located in the upper-mid dorsal region. A series of smaller, overlapping 'C' and 'O' shaped light-intensity perimeters are clustered in the posterior-lateral region, exhibiting a soft gradient transition from light perimeter to dark center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters. Small, solid white specks are sparsely distributed along the dorsal ridge and lower lateral section, distinct from the larger gradient-based annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary dorsal annulus and the two most prominent posterior-lateral annuli form an obtuse triangular configuration. The longest axis of this geometric relationship extends longitudinally toward the posterior extremity.
